items.question: In what year did the Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge launch the New School Model (NSM) in public schools?
items.fact: Abu Dhabi DEK launched New School Model in 2010

items.question: Which Emiri Decree number established the Sharjah Private Education Authority in November 2018?
items.fact: Emiri Decree No. 45 of 2018 established Sharjah Private Education Authority
